Hi @roberth 
I have started learning and working with modular services, and have given life to this one. I have migrated a module I had previously worked on at ngipkgs. See: https://github.com/ngi-nix/ngipkgs/tree/main/projects/holo/services/holo

Still understanding the workflow, and details of modular services. The documentation in the manual, and the examples thus far, have been really helpful. I look forward to your review for my learning, and I will pick more services to migrate:)

review_comments.body:
You've already created one by setting `system.services.holo-daemon`.

If needed you can adjust systemd-specific stuff using `systemd.service.*` where you can define the usual NixOS systemd service options.
Shouldn't be necessary as a option default is already set.

Yes. For a clean, prod-level version, this shouldn't be here.
I'll remove it during cleanup.

reviews.body: The modular service usage looks good to me
